Virtually all makers of cloud AI chips are using off-die memory 🕵️‍♂️ Most of them make inference ASICs.

This explains why in 2026 computer memory prices went up +100% and more in some cases 📈 Let's dig a little deeper.

At a higher level, chip architectures differ in how they approach compute cores and memory (the latter also influences memory bandwidth). Two major paradigms:

💻Cores: general-purpose (can run both AI training and inference, and even non-AI workflows) vs. application-specific (aka ASICs; typically can run either training or inference, and are incapable of running non-AI tasks).
